say:1:1411437001:1.text: Are you done causing trouble? Running around planting bombs everywhere.
say:1:1411437001:1.source_cn: 你闹够了没有，到处乱跑，到处都是炸弹！

say:2:1411437002:1.text: Do you have any idea how dangerous it is to set off explosions underground, young lady?
say:2:1411437002:1.source_cn: 你知道在地下这么随便爆炸有多危险吗？

say:4:1411437003:1.text: So what?! I'm a Hypogean! I'm evil!
say:4:1411437003:1.source_cn: 那又怎么样！我们恶魔就是这么邪恶！

say:5:1411437004:1.text: I'm going to blow everything up so you numbskulls know who you're dealing with!
say:5:1411437004:1.source_cn: 我就要炸塌一切，让你们这些看不起我的人好好瞧瞧！

say:6:1411437005:1.text: *Sigh* Indeed, this was the same madness that Kulusta exhibited back then. It seems that I don't need to hold back anymore.
say:6:1411437005:1.source_cn: ……的确，这就是库露丝塔当年癫狂的本性，看起来我也不需...

say:7:1411437006:1.text: Did I ask you to hold back?! And stop mentioning my full name! It's so uncool!
say:7:1411437006:1.source_cn: 谁用你留情！而且你提什么我以前的名字啊！土死了！

say:8:1411437007:1.text: Boomboom, it's time to teach them a lesson!
say:8:1411437007:1.source_cn: 阿爆，我们一起，给这帮家伙一点颜色看看！
